description: Was pleased, and then owned the same of your house.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Counted the boards and the shillings, and swore to nothing else.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Set the ten days against your fast, and did not get a taking.
name: Will Kemp

description: Answered the paint with a conscience, and kept their purse off this side of the river.
name: William Shakespeare
